mechanism_narrative: A Fed Funds rate above 5.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of Fed Funds rate above 5.0% and CPIAUCSL above 300 indicates persistent inflation and restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0) signals market anticipation of aggressive policy responses that boost equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High employment levels (PAYEMS > 150000) indicate a robust labor market supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 indicate deteriorating housing market conditions that increase recession risks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of low housing starts (HOUST < 1500) and low residential investment (RSAFS < 700000) indicates severe housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
